case.summary: Case HHG-018 was triggered by customer C02354 disputing an in-person transaction (ID 3491361) of $39.08 on card C02354-K2, dated 2016-11-27 13:41:26 in region 126. A review of transaction history revealed that the exact $39.08 amount occurred 11 prior times under the same product code W, establishing a recurring pattern. Upon customer outreach, the customer reviewed the recurring history and confirmed the transaction was their own legitimate subscription. Consequently, the case was resolved as legitimate with a calibrated fraud probability of 0.05.
